statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. The golang-msft-fips toolchain is built from microsoft/go; repository code search shows no import of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp under src/cmd or elsewhere in src. go.mod lists golang.org/x/crypto as a bootstrap module dependency, but the openpgp subpackage is not compiled into the shipped go/compiler binaries (vulnerable_code_not_present).

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release; see https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5932. The docker-engine APK ships dockerd built from Moby 29.7.2, which vendors github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto for OpenPGP and does not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp. go version -m on the published dockerd binary lists golang.org/x/crypto v0.55.0 as a module dependency but no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp import path, so the advisory OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifact.

No fix available for v3 incompatible version. The vulnerability requires upgrading to v4 or v5, which needs upstream code changes in minio/operator. Waiting for upstream to migrate away from the unmaintained v3 version.
